CollectionItemProperties.Description: A reminder of the triumph of spirit and sportsmanship, this gleaming trophy, engraved with the illustrious FC Anrica crest, marks your investment in the team. The stadium roars live in this symbol, capturing the essence of Sordish athleticism and camaraderie.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: FC Anrica Trophy

CollectionItemProperties.Description: Crafted in the buzzing workshops of Ventrie City, Arcasia, this sleek radio is more than a device—it's a connection. Tuned to frequencies from around the globe, it stands as a reminder of your shrewd investments, and a beacon of broadcast excellence.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Armadine Radio

CollectionItemProperties.Description: This solemn candle, lit during the Bludish community's Aschraf Anniversary event, softly whispers the stories of unity in diversity. Each flicker echoes with the strength of a people, their history and struggles, painting a picture of resilience and hope.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Aschraf Candle

CollectionItemProperties.Description: A shining golden statuette dating from the rule of Queen Lyza. The delicate floral engravings on the base symbolize the bountiful lands of Rizia, while the indomitable bull of House Toras watches over them.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Bull Figurine

CollectionItemProperties.Description: It isn't merely a key, but an emblem of speed, power, and luxury. Its cold metal holds the thrill of driving a sports car, embodying the prestige of the Randolfini brand, a classic Lespian auto giant.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Car Key

CollectionItemProperties.Description: A gleaming symbol of progress, these scissors, used to cut ribbons at infrastructure project inaugurations, are a tangible reminder of your contributions to the modern face of Sordland.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Ceremonial Scissors

CollectionItemProperties.Description: Chess is the noblest of games, a testament to the art of strategy. It has also proven to be an excellent way to pass time in palace halls. This beautiful piece was part of a set commissioned by House Azaro, as an ode to their military prowess.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Azaro Chess Piece

CollectionItemProperties.Description: A gift from Walter Tusk, this box emanates a distinct, rich aroma of tobacco leaves toasted in the Lespian sunshine and rolled by the finest Lespian cigar-makers. Each cigar within it speaks of power, wealth, and the complex intricacies of Sordish and Lespian oligarchy.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Cigar Box

CollectionItemProperties.Description: An ancient relic passed down through generations, this dagger tells tales of King Egmund's reign. A reminder of the weight of leadership, it's more than a weapon—it's a piece of Sordish history.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: King Egmund's Dagger

CollectionItemProperties.Description:
The St. Dast Scepter is a revered artifact, known for its intricate craftsmanship and deep symbolic meaning. Its handle is divided into eleven segments, each representing one of the Pillars of Nurity, adorned with symbols that embody these core principles. 

According to legend, master artisan Dorian Etxeberria had a vivid dream in which St. Dast appeared, urging him to create the scepter to encapsulate the Pillars of Nurity. Driven by this divine vision, Dorian meticulously designed and forged the scepter, believing it to be his sacred duty to honor the saint's legacy.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: St. Dast's Scepter

CollectionItemProperties.Description: Companionship, trust and most importantly loyalty are all things that should be rightfully demanded by a king from his subjects. Time after time, Bruno has proven he is better at this than most of your court. Good boy.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Bruno's Dog Toy

CollectionItemProperties.Description: Part of a series of similar eggs crafted by the famed Rumburgian goldsmith Benjamin C. Hattersley, commissioned during the late Alfred II’s reign on behalf of Rumburg’s Monarchy. Only eight are known to be in existence, with this particular piece inlaid with emeralds and lapis lazuli.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Hattersley Egg

CollectionItemProperties.Description: Rizian Oil and Gas serves as a source of pride, a symbol for the nation’s self sufficiency and independence. This industrial yet elegant looking plaque, dedicated to the Aureus Gas Field, serves as a constant reminder of the path walked to achieve this goal.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: ROG Plaque

CollectionItemProperties.Description: This intricate statue of a Sordish goat stands as a beacon of national pride. Crafted in minute detail, it's a quiet celebration of the country's heritage and natural bounty.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Sordish Goat Statue

CollectionItemProperties.Description: This stark piece of Sordish weaponry, a stark echo of conflict, weighs heavy with the tension of a nation at war. It serves as a grim reminder of the challenges Sordland faces, and the grit needed to navigate them.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Gun

CollectionItemProperties.Description: These headphones, with their tangle of wires and worn pads, have become your companion in the midst of war. Their soundscape forms a bubble of focus amidst the chaos, providing clarity when it is needed most.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Headphones

CollectionItemProperties.Description: This intricate system of interlocking rings represents the carefully crafted unity among Merkopa’s many nations. An incredible feat given their many differences and interests. May it last for many decades to come.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Intermerkopum Rings

CollectionItemProperties.Description: The ornamental key to Iza’s historical Mousser gate, symbolizing the control of House Sazon over the city. The Sazon’s cactus emblem is beautifully molded out of gold, polished and glimmering in the light.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Iza Gate Key

CollectionItemProperties.Description: A seemingly simple device that once saved a life from a bullet. Every spark it creates illuminates a tale of narrow escapes and unpredictable turns of fate.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Kesaro's Lighter

CollectionItemProperties.Description: Crowded, sun-kissed beaches adorn this postcard. Heaven to some, although others may prefer a more private, secluded seaside retreat. It’s an homage to Rizia’s blossoming tourist industry, sent with personal regards from Marcel Koronti.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Valenqiris Postcard

CollectionItemProperties.Description: A small but wickedly sharp weapon with a well-worn grip, designed to be wielded in hand-to-hand combat or hurled towards one's enemy. Its slim profile enables it to be stored very close to one's body without being detected.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Lucita's Dagger

CollectionItemProperties.Description: A few drops of this concentrated mandragora extract allow the faithful a glimpse of the religious spheres, or so the wisemen say. It is also known that a few too many drops can have catastrophic effects…
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Mandragora Extract

CollectionItemProperties.Description:
An exquisitely crafted tin bird created by the famous artisans of Morella. A simple wind up mechanism allows it to flap its wings and stamp its feet. 

Although these days a common toy in a lot of Morellan households, due to absence of mass production birds like this are prized in nations across Merkopa.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Morellan Tin Bird

CollectionItemProperties.Description: Fast, elegant, modern, but most importantly: comfortable. All amenities that could possibly be desired are present on this seafaring vessel. The RRN Rizania yacht is truly fit for a modern king and this scale model serves as a constant reminder that it’s yours.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: RRN Rizania Model

CollectionItemProperties.Description:
The Crown of Pales, although inferior to your own, is nevertheless an impressive sight. Made of solid gold and adorned with large white pearls and gemstones, it once served as a symbol of the Reinharts' reign over an independent Grand Duchy.

Now, it sits on your desk, demonstrating Rizia's rightful reclamation of the breakaway province.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Crown of Pales

CollectionItemProperties.Description: This photo, torn at the edges, speaks volumes of love lost and bridges burned. It serves as a poignant reminder of personal sacrifices made in pursuit of national leadership.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Torn Family Photo

CollectionItemProperties.Description: A timeless memento of friendship, this watch once belonged to your loyal driver, Serge Wolkner. Each tick whispers stories of camaraderie and loyalty, echoing the rhythm of your shared journey.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Serge's Pocket Watch

CollectionItemProperties.Description: Holding this book is like touching the heart of a fallen poet. Each verse within it echoes with the grief and glory of a nation, and a solitary voice silenced too soon.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Circas's Poem Book

CollectionItemProperties.Description: While there might still be some room for improvement on the poetic side of things, this poem gifted to you by your friend and butler Pabel serves as a memory of the times you have spent together, and provides hope for what is to come.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Pabel's Poem

CollectionItemProperties.Description: A shining symbol of entrepreneurial success, this trophy marks your investment in Underhall. It stands as an attestation to Sordland's infrastructural growth and the promise of prosperity.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Underhall Trophy

CollectionItemProperties.Description: Worn during the 58 election campaign, this brooch is a symbol of your political journey. Despite its small size, it carries the weight of a nation's hopes and the fierce urgency of change.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: USP Brooch

CollectionItemProperties.Description: Your wife Lena’s wedding ring, recovered from her body after the fateful boating trip. The large blue amethyst still reminds you of her eyes, your names carved into the gold a reminder of what should’ve lasted forever.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Lena's Wedding Ring

CollectionItemProperties.Description: Carved out of the finest Wehzek spruce, plated with gold and decorated with elegant gemstones, this doorstop is part of a long tradition of ornate woodworking deeply rooted in Wehlen’s heartlands. Some are known to commend its multifunctional use.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Wehzek Doorstop

CollectionItemProperties.Description: An Erlory maroon, 30 years aged—a bottle of pure harmony, each sip unfolds layers of complex flavors, transporting one to the serene highlands of Sordland.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Whiskey Bottle

CollectionItemProperties.Description: A testament to Sordland's fertile lands, this wine bottle holds a crimson elixir made from your own vineyard. Its deep notes serve as a refreshing reminder of home—a symbol of personal accomplishment and Sordish terroir.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Wine Bottle

CollectionItemProperties.Description: Discovered during preliminary explorations of the Meftiem International Trade Zone, this solid gold Wruhecist medallion is believed to be one of the oldest relics of the ancient Rezenid Empire. The remarkably preserved intricate religious engravings still carry the same symbolism as hundreds of years ago.
CollectionItemProperties.Title: Wruhecist Medallion
